name: storehouse-b
description: Storehouse, Version B (the Canal Warehouse), drawn from scratch for ROADMAP 49 (tools/blueprints/briefs/storehouse.md, REBUILD.md). MC_BUILDER = the minecraft-builder skill's folder. Until the owner picks and the critic says SHIP, 'build' writes candidates.

scripts.build: for L in 1 2 3; do ID=storehouse; [ $L = 1 ] || ID=storehouse_$L; LEVEL=$L node "$MC_BUILDER/scripts/run-build.mjs" recipe.mjs --out-dir out --data-version 3955 && python3 ../../rebuild.py storehouse_b $ID --candidate --nbt out/$(echo $ID | tr _ -).nbt --basement 4 --cellar 2,2,8,10 || exit 1; done
